summary.business_type: B2B buy-side M&A / private equity advisory firm (Mumbai, India; active across India, UK, UAE, MENA, Europe, APAC)
top_findings: CRITICAL: Homepage has a stuck 'Loading Sky...' WebGL asset creating ~17,500px of dead scroll space between the hero and main content (components/ThreeScene.tsx)
CRITICAL: ~94MB of unoptimized images sitewide (54 sitemap images), 16 exceeding 1MB, ten Stories-page PNGs at 7-9.2MB each; zero next/image, WebP/AVIF, or responsive srcset usage
CRITICAL: Deprecated HowTo schema (removed by Google Sept 2023) still live on /approach and /stories/[slug] pages, polluting Search Console
HIGH: Apex domain kautilya-pe.com redirects to www with a temporary 307 instead of a permanent 301/308
HIGH: news-sitemap.xml misapplies the Google News protocol to evergreen /stories/* content, several dated 2024, likely generating persistent GSC errors
HIGH: No standalone 'buy-side due diligence' service page despite that SERP being dominated by dedicated service pages
HIGH: Primary 'ENGAGE' CTA hidden behind a hamburger menu on mobile, invisible above the fold
HIGH: Off-site authority signals (no Wikipedia, no Reddit, unverified YouTube activity) remain the primary AI-citation/GEO score cap
MEDIUM: Confirmed content cannibalization between /blog/what-is-a-search-fund and /stories/search-funds
MEDIUM: Two heavily keyword-targeted topics (off-market deal sourcing, buy-side due diligence checklist) have zero dedicated pillar content
quick_wins: Set apex-to-www redirect to permanent 301/308 in Vercel domain settings
Delete deprecated HowTo JSON-LD blocks from /approach and /stories/[slug] pages
Fix llms.txt FAQ count mismatch (23 -> 26 questions, one-line edit)
Remove news-sitemap.xml route and its robots.txt reference (stories already covered by sitemap.xml)
Add explicit width/height to portfolio-logo tags to close a CLS risk

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 35 sitemap URLs return HTTP 200, no 404s or soft-404s
Every sampled page is SSG (x-nextjs-prerender: 1, is_spa: false) with no CSR/SPA dependency
Complete, consistent security headers sitewide (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) via next.config.ts
Canonical tags and meta robots are clean, unique, and correct on every page sampled
Valid multi-type JSON-LD on every sampled page
llms.txt and llms-full.txt both resolve and are comprehensive
HTTP to HTTPS redirects are clean single-hop 308s

findings.title: Apex domain uses a temporary 307 redirect instead of permanent 301/308
findings.description: http://kautilya-pe.com/ -> 308 -> https://kautilya-pe.com/ -> 307 -> https://www.kautilya-pe.com/ is a 3-hop chain with a non-permanent final hop, inconsistent with the clean 308 seen on the www variant.
findings.recommendation: Set the redirect type for kautilya-pe.com -> www.kautilya-pe.com to Permanent (308) in Vercel Domains settings, or add an explicit vercel.json/next.config.ts redirect with permanent: true.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy are all present sitewide but no CSP or CSP-Report-Only header is defined anywhere in next.config.ts headers().
findings.recommendation: Add a CSP header scoped to known third-party origins (Google Tag Manager, the five badge domains, Unsplash) in next.config.ts headers().

findings.title: No IndexNow protocol support
findings.description: No IndexNow key file or submission integration found in the codebase, despite regular /newsletter and /stories publishing that would benefit from instant Bing/Yandex crawl notification.
findings.recommendation: Generate an IndexNow key, host it at /{key}.txt, and add a submission call triggered on publish for /blog/[slug], /newsletter/[slug], /stories/[slug].

findings.title: Sitewide WebGL SplashCursor effect is a latent INP risk
findings.description: A continuous per-pointer-move WebGL fluid-dye simulation runs on every route via SplashCursorWrapper in the root layout. Deferred via next/dynamic so it doesn't block LCP, but competes with click/tap handlers on the main thread.
findings.recommendation: Lab-test INP with the cursor effect active vs. disabled; gate it to pointer-fine devices only via window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)') so mobile visitors skip it entirely.

findings.title: Homepage canonical omits trailing slash
findings.description: Homepage is served at https://www.kautilya-pe.com/ but its canonical tag reads https://www.kautilya-pe.com (no trailing slash), inconsistent with every other page's exact-match canonical.
findings.recommendation: Add the trailing slash to the homepage canonical to match observed serving behavior exactly.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Specific, falsifiable case-study numbers (99.83% match rate, 30,134 transactions, named deal values) verified present in rendered HTML, not just marketing copy
Full 8-person named team roster with roles and LinkedIn links on /team
Dated, bylined long-form content with real publish dates matching JSON-LD
Newsletter deal-teardowns are the strongest content asset (sourced stats, scored rubric, tables)
Zero AI-pattern filler language detected on any sampled page
Good topical depth on long-form pages (1,700-3,300 words)

findings.title: Single-author concentration across all long-form content
findings.description: All 8 sampled blog/newsletter/story posts are bylined 'Dev Shah' only, despite 6 other named specialists on /team whose expertise is never attributed to specific published content.
findings.recommendation: Attribute posts to the team member with domain expertise, or add a 'Reviewed by' credit line, to diversify the expertise signal.

findings.title: No visible per-post author bio or credentials block
findings.description: Articles show 'Dev Shah - [date]' only with no inline bio, headshot, or credentials snippet; the founder bio only exists on /team and in JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add a short author byline block (1-2 sentences + photo + link to /team) at the top or bottom of every long-form post.

findings.title: No visible phone number or physical address in body copy
findings.description: Across all 15 pages sampled, the only visible contact signal is an email address; no street address or phone number appears in rendered text anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Add a visible registered office address and contact phone number to /team, /engage, and the footer to strengthen Trustworthiness E-E-A-T.

findings.title: Homepage body copy is thin relative to a 500-word floor
findings.description: Stripped of nav/footer boilerplate, the homepage yields ~357 words of substantive body copy, below the typical homepage topical-coverage floor.
findings.recommendation: Add 2-3 more substantive paragraphs surfacing the track-record stats on-page, not just in llms.txt.

findings.title: Stories case-study stats remain prose-only with no tables/visuals
findings.description: Flagship stats-heavy case studies (e.g. /stories/inspire3) deliver numbers as prose only, with no supporting chart or table, unlike the newsletter's table pattern.
findings.recommendation: Add at minimum one summary-stats visual per Stories case study, matching the newsletter's table pattern.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Consistent 'PageName | Kautilya | Keywords' title pattern across all pages sampled
Exactly one H1 per page on every page sampled, no missing/duplicate H1s
Every page has a unique meta description
Canonical tags present and correct on every page, all pointing to the www host
robots meta consistently index,follow with no accidental noindex
OG:title distinct from and complementary to the SEO title on long-form pages

findings.title: Multiple meta descriptions exceed the ~155-160 character SERP display limit
findings.description: 9 of 16 sampled pages have over-length meta descriptions; worst offender is the Torrent-JB Chemicals newsletter post at 255 characters, risking truncation in search results.
findings.recommendation: Trim to 150-155 characters with the most compelling/keyword-relevant clause first.

findings.title: /portfolio and /newsletter have zero H2 subheadings
findings.description: Both list-style pages rely on a single H1 with no subheading structure despite listing multiple distinct case studies/newsletter issues.
findings.recommendation: Add H2s per portfolio company / per newsletter issue for on-page structure and accessibility.

findings.title: Portfolio-logo and OG images missing width/height attributes
findings.description: Portfolio company logos render as plain tags with no explicit dimensions, creating CLS risk.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit width/height (or migrate to next/image, which enforces this).

findings.title: Third-party badge images hotlinked on key pages
findings.description: Homepage and /portfolio embed external badges from five low-authority directory sites via direct hotlinked tags, adding external DNS/connection overhead.
findings.recommendation: Self-host or remove these badges given limited relevance to a B2B M&A advisory audience.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: Fully SSR'd, valid JSON on every block sampled, no malformed/truncated data
Unusually complete Organization schema (foundingDate, areaServed, knowsAbout, founder, sameAs)
BreadcrumbList present on every deep page sampled
Person schema for all 8 team members with jobTitle and sameAs
BlogPosting correctly used for blog posts with all required and recommended properties
Absolute URLs and ISO 8601 dates throughout, correct SearchAction formatting

findings.title: Deprecated HowTo schema still in production
findings.description: Google removed HowTo rich results in September 2023. This markup is live on /approach and conditionally on /stories/[slug] pages, earning nothing and polluting Search Console's Enhancements report.
findings.recommendation: Remove the howToSchema block from /approach and the howToLd block from stories pages entirely; leave visible HTML content in place.

findings.title: FAQPage markup has no Google SERP benefit as of the audit date
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on 2026-05-07. FAQPage markup site-wide produces no SERP feature currently, though it may still aid AI/GEO extraction.
findings.recommendation: No urgent action; if kept, label internally as GEO-only, unconfirmed benefit rather than rich-result schema.

findings.title: FAQ question-count mismatch between llms.txt and live FAQPage schema
findings.description: llms.txt states 23 answered questions; live FAQPage JSON-LD contains 26 Question items.
findings.recommendation: Update llms.txt to state 26 answered questions.

findings.title: Two separate top-level entities for the same business with no @id linkage
findings.description: Homepage emits both an Organization and a ProfessionalService for Kautilya independently, with drifting offer-catalog details (one includes pricing, the other doesn't) and no @id to declare they're the same entity.
findings.recommendation: Give the canonical Organization a stable @id (e.g. https://www.kautilya-pe.com/#organization) and reference it from WebSite.publisher and ProfessionalService; reconcile the pricing discrepancy.

findings.title: NewsArticle type used for evergreen Stories content
findings.description: Stories and Newsletter pages both use @type: NewsArticle, but Stories are evergreen case studies, not time-sensitive journalism.
findings.recommendation: Change Stories pages to plain Article or BlogPosting; keep NewsArticle on Newsletter posts, which do track live deal news.

findings.title: Malformed empty-string servicePhone property
findings.description: app/approach/page.tsx sets servicePhone: '' inside ServiceChannel, an invalid placeholder value.
findings.recommendation: Remove the servicePhone key entirely or populate with a real number.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Excellent TTFB across all pages tested (55-109ms)
Brotli compression confirmed sitewide
Static assets cached with immutable, max-age=31536000
Self-hosted next/font woff2 fonts with font-display: swap, no FOIT, no third-party Google Fonts round trip
Content fully server-rendered with no CSR dependency for LCP-relevant content
Blog images correctly use next/image with responsive srcSet and explicit dimensions

findings.title: Portfolio logo images missing width/height (CLS risk)
findings.description: Two logo images on /portfolio are raw tags with no dimensions and no next/image optimization, unlike the blog template which correctly uses next/image.
findings.recommendation: Convert to next/image or add explicit width/height attributes.

findings.title: Five third-party badge images from five external domains on every page
findings.description: Badge images from five separate external origins load identically on home, /approach, /portfolio, blog, and stories pages, adding DNS/TLS overhead for content irrelevant to the target audience.
findings.recommendation: Self-host or lazy-load these badge images; consider removing entirely.

findings.title: HTML responses use Cache-Control: max-age=0, must-revalidate
findings.description: Browser is told to revalidate HTML on every navigation rather than serving from disk cache, though Vercel's ISR edge caching (300s revalidate) already compensates well given the low TTFBs measured.
findings.recommendation: Consider explicit s-maxage/stale-while-revalidate tuning if perceived back/forward navigation speed becomes a priority; low impact at current TTFB levels.

findings.title: No CrUX/PSI field or full Lighthouse data obtained
findings.description: No Google API credentials configured in this environment; PageSpeed Insights returned a rate-limit error on every attempt. All performance findings are lab-based estimates from curl timing and header inspection.
findings.recommendation: Re-run PageSpeed Insights / CrUX Vis once API access is available to confirm lab signals hold under real user conditions, particularly mobile INP.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% alt-text coverage across all ~92 images sampled on 16 pages, zero missing or empty alt attributes
loading=lazy used on below-the-fold avatar images
Logo/icon assets are SVG, small footprint
Descriptive, semantic image filenames

findings.title: Story/blog images are massively oversized
findings.description: Total payload of ~94MB across the 54 images referenced in image-sitemap.xml; 16 of 54 (30%) exceed 1MB, with ten Stories-page PNGs at 7-9.2MB each (e.g. /images/stories/borderless/exhausting-market.png at 9.22MB).
findings.recommendation: Re-export chart/diagram images at a sane display resolution (<=1600px wide), compress with a tool like squoosh/sharp, convert to WebP or AVIF, targeting <150-250KB per content image.

findings.title: No modern image format usage, zero next/image optimization pipeline
findings.description: Every image is served as raw .png/.jpg/.jpeg directly from static paths with zero requests through /_next/image, confirming plain tags are used instead of Next.js's built-in image optimization.
findings.recommendation: Migrate all content/avatar/portfolio-logo usages to next/image for automatic responsive srcset, lazy-loading, CLS prevention, and WebP/AVIF serving.

findings.title: No responsive srcset, identical image served to mobile and desktop
findings.description: srcset appears 0 times across homepage, /portfolio, and /stories HTML; a mobile visitor downloads the identical multi-megabyte asset as a desktop visitor.
findings.recommendation: Same fix as next/image migration above.

findings.title: Missing width/height on portfolio-logo and badge images
findings.description: Portfolio company logos render without explicit dimensions, contributing to Cumulative Layout Shift.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit dimensions to every or migrate to next/image.

findings.title: Third-party hotlinked badge images on homepage/portfolio
findings.description: Badges from five external directory sites add extra DNS/TLS round-trips on key pages.
findings.recommendation: Self-host or remove if these directory badges provide negligible referral/SEO value.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows every major AI crawler (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Applebot-Extended, cohere-ai, YouBot)
llms.txt (91 lines) and llms-full.txt (676 lines) both resolve and are content-rich, with explicit citation-provenance guidance
Headline statistics quoted in llms.txt verified to appear verbatim in actual on-page rendered content
Fully static, JS-independent delivery confirmed on every page sampled (mode_used: raw, is_spa: false)
New SpeakableSpecification schema block adds voice-AI eligibility
FAQPage schema with 26 Q&A pairs correctly typed
Newsletter's sourced tables and Sources: attribution line are the strongest citability asset on the site

findings.title: Off-site authority signals remain the primary score cap
findings.description: No Wikipedia entity for Kautilya or Dev Shah, no Reddit presence, and the linked YouTube channel's activity could not be verified due to a consent-wall. YouTube mentions correlate most strongly (~0.737) with AI citation odds of any signal in the GEO framework.
findings.recommendation: Pursue a sustained off-site footprint: YouTube video output tied to existing deal-teardown content, Reddit participation in relevant subreddits, and eventual Wikipedia notability.

findings.title: Flagship stats-heavy case study has zero in-content visuals or video
findings.description: /stories/inspire3 (99.83% match rate case study) has no charts, screenshots, or diagrams supporting its own claims despite dense quantified content.
findings.recommendation: Add at minimum one summary-stats visual per Stories case study; embed 1-2 relevant videos on /approach and high-traffic Stories pages.

findings.title: llms-full.txt excludes Stories full text
findings.description: llms-full.txt's header claims complete Blog and Newsletter article coverage but excludes the richest quantified case-study detail found in Stories pages.
findings.recommendation: Extend llms-full.txt to include full Stories/case-study text, or add a separate /llms-stories.txt referenced from /llms.txt.

findings.title: News sitemap misapplies news protocol to evergreen content
findings.description: news-sitemap.xml still carries 2024-dated publication_date values for evergreen Stories content, coordinated with the same finding filed as High severity in the Sitemap category.
findings.recommendation: Remove Stories URLs from news-sitemap.xml entirely unless pursuing actual Google News inclusion.

findings.title: FAQ answers remain snippet-length only
findings.description: FAQ answers run 26-53 words, good for Google AI Overview/voice extraction but thin for Perplexity-style multi-source synthesis, which favors longer self-contained passages.
findings.recommendation: Link each short FAQ answer to a 134-167 word expanded answer in corresponding blog/approach content.

supplementary_analyses.name: Search Experience Optimization (SXO)
supplementary_analyses.note: Not included in the weighted health score; supplements the On-Page and Content categories with SERP-backwards page-type-mismatch analysis.
